changes.before: The monetary backdrop remains patient. Reuters quotes Lane saying the ECB should wait for uncertainty to recede, while the Wall Street Journal reports holds across several meetings as a possibility. Lower policy rates have not guaranteed rapid relief. Credit spreads, demand and political risk can still determine the effective cost of capital, especially for businesses whose earnings depend on domestic decisions. Look for actual customer activity before treating the first cut as a complete cyclical upgrade. [[n1577]] [[n1578]]
changes.after: The monetary backdrop remains patient. Reuters quotes Lane saying the ECB should wait for uncertainty to recede, while the Wall Street Journal reports holds across several meetings as a possibility. A lower policy rate would not by itself guarantee rapid relief. Credit spreads, demand and political risk can still determine the effective cost of capital, especially for businesses whose earnings depend on domestic decisions. Look for actual customer activity before treating an easier policy path as a complete cyclical upgrade. [[n1577]] [[n1578]]
changes.rationale: Conditional ECB easing transmission replaces unsupported first-cut completion language.

changes.before: Investopedia reports Adobe shares jumping after an AI-related earnings beat. The result provides a commercial software counterpoint to infrastructure demand, while the cost of delivering new functionality and the durability of customer adoption remain important. The preceding regular cash session does not measure the after-hours result response. [[n1096]]
changes.after: Yahoo Finance reports Adobe's second-quarter earnings. Quarterly performance provides a software reporting checkpoint alongside infrastructure demand. Adoption must improve profitable revenue after development and delivery costs, with customer willingness to pay for useful functionality determining whether the commercial proposition can sustain attractive cash generation. [[n1469]]
changes.rationale: Root found n1096 specific article aftercut; n1469 now establishes only quarterly-report completion, not beat or price reaction.

changes.before: The favorable pattern has a more concrete software component. Investopedia reports Adobe shares jumping after an AI-related earnings beat, while Reuters reports Broadcom raising its revenue forecast on chip demand. These are different business models with commercially relevant evidence, not merely the same technology slogan. The earnings beat is completed; the revenue outlook is management's expectation. Both still need future conversion to justify a valuation that may already reflect greater confidence in the theme. [[n1096]] [[n0932]]
changes.after: The favorable pattern centers on an outlook backed by identified demand. Reuters reports Broadcom shares rising as AI-chip demand powers a forecast increase. The price response is completed, while the revenue outlook is management's expectation. Yahoo Finance reports Adobe's second-quarter earnings, providing a separate software reporting checkpoint. Compare the business models by demand, delivery cost and retained cash rather than treating AI exposure as an earnings result in itself. The optimistic forecast still requires commercial conversion to support a valuation that may already reflect greater confidence. [[n1117]] [[n0932]] [[n1469]]
changes.rationale: Remove excluded n1096; Broadcom n1117 anchors completed favorable share reaction and n1469 only quarterly-report status.

changes.before: Reuters reports the Mountain Valley gas pipeline preparing to start. changes.after: Reuters reports the Mountain Valley gas pipeline preparing to start. Startup remains pending in that account. Moving from construction toward operation brings commissioning and commercial delivery into focus, with the cash benefit depending on reliable service and the contract terms customers accept. changes.rationale: Replace editorial ownership disclaimer with startup/commissioning/cash mechanism.

changes.before: A diversified energy-infrastructure fund offers an instrument type to examine, with indirect exposure and other assets. A focused issuer would require a supported ownership role and contract economics. Commissioning, utilization and financing determine whether a completed asset produces the cash expected of it.
changes.after: XLE offers broad energy-sector exposure, with risks that extend well beyond pipeline operation; it provides no precise claim on Mountain Valley's cash. A focused project investment would need confirmed ownership and contract economics. Commissioning, utilization and financing determine whether an asset produces the cash expected of it.
changes.rationale: Repair unnamed infrastructure fund to eligible XLE broad sector exposure; explicitly reject precise pipeline-cash claim.

changes.before: Investopedia reports MicroStrategy planning to raise money to buy more Bitcoin. That is a proposed financing-and-treasury action, not a completed purchase or proof of market-wide institutional demand. CNBC reports miners who attended Trump's meeting saying he viewed Bitcoin as useful to an AI competition strategy. Preserve the attribution to participants and the distinction between political statements and enacted rules. Reuters' report of Riot challenging Bitfarms' takeover defense adds a separate governance issue. The ecosystem contains financing, policy and corporate-control catalysts, but they do not form a single measure of token demand or guarantee that every business benefits. [[n1193]] [[n1110]] [[n0925]]
changes.after: Investopedia reports MicroStrategy planning to raise money to buy more Bitcoin. That is a proposed financing-and-treasury action, not a completed purchase or proof of market-wide institutional demand. CNBC reports miners who attended Trump's meeting saying he viewed Bitcoin as useful to an AI competition strategy. Participants' characterization of the meeting does not establish an enacted policy change. Reuters' report of Riot challenging Bitfarms' takeover defense adds a separate governance issue. The ecosystem contains financing, policy and corporate-control catalysts, but they do not form a single measure of token demand or guarantee that every business benefits. [[n1193]] [[n1110]] [[n0925]]
changes.rationale: Replace editorial attribution instruction with direct distinction between participants account and enacted policy.
